Definition: apparently a primary word; a "son" (sometimes of animals), used very widely of immediate, remote or figuratively, kinship:--child, foal, son.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, huiós is the word for a son, a child. In Matthew 1:1, the text says "the son of David." In Mark 1:11, the text says "Thou art my beloved Son."
TheologicalSignificance: Reading huiós this way, I believe family is God's idea, and the bonds He builds there are meant to hold. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
RelatedEvents: The Baptism of Jesus; The Birth of Jesus; The Birth of John the Baptist
